item.fullDescription:
SF Tech Week is coming to GSB! Join us for an evening with founders building globally from San Francisco, and the VCs who back them.
We will open with a short panel on where U.S. and LatAm opportunities are converging: payments, the agentic AI wave, and more. Our speakers:
Julian Nuñez, co-founder and CEO of Yuno Daniel Ospina, co-founder of Pygma, one of LatAm's fastest-growing accelerators, with two recent YC companies VC Fund to confirm
Matteo Gilliotti (MSx '27, previously a VC investor in LatAm) will open the evening.
Afterward, stay for the sunset at Arbuckle with some great beers, and meet the founders and investors in the room.

item.title: A conversation on Manufacturing in Africa with Africa Job Fund
item.description: Join us for A Conversation About African Manufacturing with Ben from the Africa Jobs Fund. From turning overlooked opportunities into real companies to connecting African talent and products with global markets, this is a conve...
item.fullDescription: Join us for A Conversation About African Manufacturing with Ben from the Africa Jobs Fund. We’ll explore what it takes to build globally competitive manufacturing businesses in Africa and how export-led industry can create durable, higher-paying jobs at scale. From turning overlooked opportunities into real companies to connecting African talent and products with global markets, this is a conversation for anyone interested in the continent’s industrial future.

item.fullDescription: 60-minute fireside chat for MBA2s/MSx students with Speechify CEO Cliff Weitzman. Cliff started Speechify in college at Brown to help with my dyslexia and ADHD. In college he did 42 hackathons and launched 36 products. Today speechify has 60 million users and ~200 software engineers & designers, they are remote first and have several teammates who are currently in University, masters, PHD while working at Speechify (actively hiring). Speechify's Voice AI model is benchmarked above 11L, OpenAI, Gemini, Nvidia, etc for quality while being faster and 10x more affordable than models like 11L. They just crossed 1M five star reviews and recently won the Apple Design Award.
